s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic ocular surface disorder with progressive vision loss and conjunctival scarring
key_facts: 43-year-old man
Initial visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Symblepharon formation present
Corneal neovascularizations present
Conjunctival hyperemia present
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic ocular surface disorder with progressive vision loss and conjunctival scarring
key_facts: 43-year-old man

Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis

differentials: Sjögren's Syndrome with Interstitial Lung Disease
per_call: Sjögren's Syndrome with Interstitial Lung Disease

shortlist.label: Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival scarring and symblepharon formation are characteristic features

shortlist.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Subconjunctival fibrosis and corneal neovascularizations are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Chronic Ocular Graft-Versus-Host Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive vision loss and conjunctival hyperemia are possible manifestations

shortlist.label: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival hyperemia and corneal neovascularizations could be seen in this condition

shortlist.label: Idiopathic Subconjunctival Fibrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subconjunctival fibrosis is a key feature, and other findings could be secondary to this process

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, and corneal neovascularizations are characteristic features of Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid, which is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects the conjunctiva and cornea.

rejected.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
rejected.why: While it shares some similar symptoms, Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid typically involves other mucous membranes beyond the eyes, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Chronic Ocular Graft-Versus-Host Disease
rejected.why: This condition is typically seen in patients with a history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
rejected.why: This is an acute condition that typically presents with a sudden onset of symptoms, whereas the vignette describes a chronic progression of eye symptoms.

rejected.label: Idiopathic Subconjunctival Fibrosis
rejected.why: While subconjunctival fibrosis is present, the other symptoms such as symblepharon formation and corneal neovascularizations suggest a more complex condition like Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid.
